about.manifestoTwo: I figure them out by building.
about.copy: I run technology in a live operation. Servers, networks, the systems people only notice when they fail. That job taught me to see the snag first, then build the tool. Monitoring software, internal platforms, digital products — they all come from that job.

contact.copy: If it's already in production, half-finished, or messy — that's usually worth talking about.

ping-alert-v2.description: A desktop app that watches the network.
ping-alert-v2.problem: When a switch dies, the room finds out too late. Monitoring was either everywhere or nowhere.
ping-alert-v2.idea: One app on the desk. It watches the network and alerts the moment something stops answering.
ping-alert-v2.build: Desktop, not a browser tab. It sits on an operations machine and keeps watching.
ping-alert-v2.result: It exists because the network needed it. Not because a dashboard looked impressive.
ping-alert-v2.caption: ICMP / LIVE

laniff.problem: Hardware, licenses, and locations lived in spreadsheets. Nobody trusted the count.
laniff.idea: One place for what exists, where it is, and who owns it.
laniff.build: A proper system, not a form. Structure, history, and clear ownership.
laniff.result: An internal product to keep inventory honest.
laniff.caption: ASSET REGISTER

guest-assist-ai.problem: Guests ask the same questions at all hours. Staff already have a full shift.
guest-assist-ai.idea: An assistant that knows the property. It helps. It doesn't pretend to replace the front desk.
guest-assist-ai.build: Built from real guest questions. Not a generic chatbot demo.
guest-assist-ai.result: Still in the lab. Useful first.
guest-assist-ai.caption: GUEST / QUERY

it-toolkit.problem: The same work kept hiding in scripts, notes, and one-off fixes.
it-toolkit.idea: A kit of internal tools. Unspectacular. Faster for the people who use them.
it-toolkit.build: Collected as I go. Utilities, checks, small systems. They stay if they get used.
it-toolkit.result: A workshop. Not a finished product.
it-toolkit.caption: MODULES
